page.summary: Bank tokens as generators finish, then use your own repair finish for a brief rotation burst and healing progress when the next job can use them.

verdict.recommendation: Treat Fruits of Your Labor as a provisional objective-to-reset bonus, not a reason to finish the wrong generator or promise a full heal.
verdict.soloQ: Work a useful generator and plan the destination after its finish; accept the bonus when it arrives without holding a nearly complete machine for a heal.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Call who owns the finish and whether anyone actually needs the subsequent reset or rotation; ordinary objective coverage remains the priority.
verdict.mainWeakness: Other generator completions only bank tokens. The Haste and Healing progress require your own repair finish, and their value depends on the next game state.

options.whyItsHere: Every completed generator grants a token; finishing repair yourself activates per-token 5% Haste for two seconds and 10/15/20% Healing progress by tier.

opening: Choose a generator worth finishing regardless of the perk. There is no canonical four-perk implementation or required item for this experimental strategy.

rows.situation: Any generator is completed while Fruits of Your Labor is equipped.
rows.action: Note the gained token, then keep the best current objective or rescue assignment; do not expect an immediate Haste or heal effect from that completion alone.
rows.why: The token is banked at completion, but the payoff has a separate finishing-repair trigger.

rows.situation: You are finishing repair on a useful generator and have banked tokens.
rows.action: Finish the repair, then use the per-token 5% Haste for two seconds to reach the next safe job. Count the 10/15/20% Healing progress per token as reset value only if a heal is actually useful now.
rows.why: The effect triggers on your repair finish, not on a teammate's finish elsewhere; brief movement and healing progress have different follow-up uses.

rows.situation: The selected generator is denied, a hook needs coverage, or no reset is needed.
rows.action: Take the higher-value job and let the perk wait for a later legitimate finish. Do not delay an objective or force a heal merely to demonstrate the bonus.
rows.why: The strategy loses value when activation timing overrides objective and hook-state priorities.

abortWhen: Abandon a contested or low-value finish; the banked-token plan is not worth a down or an uncovered rescue.

strengths: Main-objective progress can carry a short movement and healing-progress benefit into the next rotation.
weaknesses: Requires generator completions and your own repair finish; healing progress may have no immediate use.
commonMistakes: Treating any generator completion as the immediate payoff trigger.
Forcing a reset or delaying a finish to extract value from a provisional bonus.
